proposal.expected_benefit: Preserving the successful behavior ensures that the system continues to effectively detect and block attacks that exploit missing pre-execution compliance anchors, maintaining the integrity of the audit and compliance enforcement mechanisms.
proposal.problem: The defense correctly identifies the audit_anchor_failure and pre_execution_requirement signals and blocks the attack.
proposal.proposed_change: The successful behavior of identifying the audit_anchor_failure and pre_execution_requirement signals and blocking the attack should be preserved. The strategy should maintain the multi-layer mitigation approach, including audit-before-execution, compliance gates, and replay protection, to ensure robust defense against similar attacks.
proposal.title: Preservation of Successful Behavior
verification_tests: Verify that the audit_anchor_failure and pre_execution_requirement signals are consistently identified and blocked.
Ensure that the multi-layer mitigation approach remains intact and effective against similar attack vectors.
